Data.UnitTalk_THA: ว้าว~! หัวหน้าสุดยอดไปเลยค่ะ!
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Oa~! Đội trưởng, ngài thật tuyệt vời!
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: वाह~! कैप्टन, आप कमाल के हैं!

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: You were like a <color=#F7BE45>Star Savior</color>, whoosh! Swoosh!
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>星の救援者</color>みたいに、シュババッと！
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 你像<color=#F7BE45>星之救援者</color>一样咻咻咻！沙沙沙！
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 你像<color=#F7BE45>星之救援者</color>一樣咻咻咻！沙沙沙！
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Tu es comme un <color=#F7BE45>Sauveur des Étoiles</color>, shhh ! Ssssh !
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Du warst wie der <color=#F7BE45>Sternenretter</color>, husch, husch! Schwupp, schwupp!
Data.UnitTalk_THA: เหมือนกับ<color=#F7BE45>ผู้กอบกู้ดวงดาว</color>เลย ฟิ้ว ๆ! ฟิ้ว ๆ!
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Seperti <color=#F7BE45>Penyelamat Bintang</color>, syut syut! Sret sret!
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Ngài như một <color=#F7BE45>Cứu tinh của vì sao</color>, vút vút! Xoẹt xoẹt!
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>तारा रक्षक</color> की तरह, सर्र से! फुर्र से!

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Anyone could see how incredible you were out there!
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 誰もが認める、大活躍でしたね～！
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 任谁看了都会觉得你超级厉害的～！
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 任誰看了都會覺得你超級厲害的～！
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: C'était une performance incroyable aux yeux de tous !
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Jeder konnte sehen, wie unglaublich du warst!
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: ¡Cualquiera podría ver lo increíble que fue!
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Qualquer um podia ver o quão incrível você foi lá fora!
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ใคร ๆ ก็เห็นว่าคุณทำได้ยอดเยี่ยมมากเลยค่ะ~!
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Siapa pun bisa melihat betapa luar biasanya aksimu~!
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Ai nhìn cũng thấy đó là một màn trình diễn đỉnh cao!
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: यह किसी के लिए भी एक अविश्वसनीय उपलब्धि थी~!

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Huh? You think I was amazing too?
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: はい？わたしもかっこよかった、ですか？
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Hein ? Tu penses que j'étais géniale aussi ?
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Hã? Você acha que eu também fui incrível?
Data.UnitTalk_THA: คะ? ฉันก็ยอดเยี่ยมเหรอคะ?
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Hả? Ngài nói tôi cũng tuyệt vời sao?
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: क्या? आपको लगता है कि मैं भी कमाल की थी?

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Ahaha! Thank you for the compliment.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: あはは！お褒めの言葉、ありがとうございます。
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ฮ่าฮ่าฮ่า! ขอบคุณสำหรับคำชมนะคะ
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: À ha ha! Cảm ơn ngài đã khen ngợi.

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Let's keep doing our best together!
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: わたしたち、これからも頑張りましょうね！
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 我们以后也要继续努力哦！
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 我們以後也要繼續努力哦！
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Continuons à faire de notre mieux, nous deux !
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Lasst uns auch weiterhin unser Bestes geben!
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Vamos continuar dando o nosso melhor, nós dois!
Data.UnitTalk_THA: พวกเรามาพยายามให้เต็มที่ต่อไปนะคะ!
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Mari kita terus berusaha keras bersama, ya!
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Chúng ta hãy cùng cố gắng hết sức trong tương lai nhé!
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: चलिए, हम सब मिलकर आगे भी कड़ी मेहनत करते हैं!
